stem_block:
Questions 1-4 refer to Passage A15 - Teaching a Plant to Defend Itself Faster

The molecule at the centre of this work, (1) ........ , is made naturally by many plants and is given off in larger amounts by damaged tissue. It was already known that treated plants became less attractive to certain insects, but nobody had settled whether the substance builds defences outright or merely leaves them ready to be built. To find out, young maize seedlings were sprayed with a weak water-based emulsion of it while their controls received the wetting agent alone, and both lots then stood for a full day in a glasshouse kept at (2) ........ degrees before the infestation began. Each seedling was afterwards sealed in a chamber so that whatever its leaves released could be caught and identified. Over the first six hours the treated plants gave off more of two sesquiterpenes than untreated plants that were equally infested. By (3) ........ hours, though, the two groups could no longer be told apart. A second run dispensed with insects altogether: leaves were lightly scratched and painted with jasmonic acid at (4) ........ to imitate an attack, and the treated plants again reacted harder on the first day. The team regards the brevity of the advantage as exactly what preparation, rather than outright activation, would predict.

Questions 5-8 refer to Passage A19 - Turning Salt Water into Drinking Water with Sunlight

Once the still had been assembled the team simply watched it work, taking a reading every hour from 08:00 until (5) ........ and measuring what each hour had produced. The best conditions proved to be both sets of mirrors in use with the water only two centimetres deep. Taking the outside mirror away cost more than extra depth did: the shallow version dropped to 7.84 litres a day, while the deeper one sank to (6) ........ litres, the weakest of the four trials. On the stricter exergy scale, which asks how much genuinely useful work the sunlight performed, even the best run scored only (7) ........ per cent, far below its score on the plain energy measure and a reminder that most of what is captured leaves as low-grade heat rather than as fresh water. The whole exercise was the work of a team at an engineering university in (8) ........ , who had taken a plain still of a familiar design apart and rebuilt it piece by piece to find out what each change was worth.

Questions 9-15 refer to Passage G07 - What Houseplants Really Do to the Air Indoors

The first of three studies borrowed three closely matched offices in a well-insulated Australian building and measured each of them empty, lightly planted and heavily planted, with the air conditioning switched off and the sensors placed (9) ........ metres above the floor, roughly where a seated worker breathes. Only dampness responded. With no plants at all the median relative humidity sat at 29.1 per cent, dry enough to leave eyes and throats uncomfortable, while the fullest arrangement of ferns lifted it to (10) ........ per cent. Neither the temperature of the rooms nor their carbon dioxide moved at all.

The second study shut a single plant at a time inside a sealed cube and pumped particles through it at three strengths, the weakest around 800 and the strongest about (11) ........ per cubic centimetre. Leaf surfaces mattered more than expected: the species that trapped most was the (12) ........ , whose leaves carry deep grooves and fine hairs on both faces, whereas the smoothest and least hairy leaves in the set trapped least. Rinsing came next: to find out what had actually stuck to the leaves, they were washed in (13) ........ water and shaken, since only what came off the surface could be weighed. The awkward finding came when the chambers were fed ordinary outdoor air instead of the mist prepared for the earlier runs, for they then no longer reliably held less than the empty control: at eight in the morning the honey locust's chamber held more, and by six in the evening so did the (14) ........ . The paper does put forward a reason for this, though it is one the chamber readings alone cannot settle.

The third study asked about people rather than air. (15) ........ office workers each sat for five minutes in a bare room, in a room planted in a Japanese style and in a room of tropical species before taking attention tests. Mood and test performance were both recorded after every stay.

yeniden_uretim.faz: B3 / FAZ 1.5 - ozet tamamlama paketi sifirdan yeniden yazildi
yeniden_uretim.yol_gerekcesi: Kutu (word_bank) kurulmadi. Listeden secmeli alt tur olcumde %71 sizinti verdi; kutu korunacaksa adaylarin en az ikisinin cerceveye oturmasi gerekiyordu. Bu paketteki her bosluk metnin KENDI sectigi bir ada/sayiya aciliyor, dolayisiyla kutu kurmak adaylarin tamamini disaridan gorulebilir kilardi (bir sayi listesi verildiginde aday buyukluk sirasindan cikarim yapar). Kelime-yazmali yol hem receteye uygun hem de bu bosluklarda daha dayanikli.
yeniden_uretim.bosluk_gerekcesi: 2026-08-18 nokta duzeltmesi - paketler arasi kanit cakismasi: eski yuva G07 H/3'e (sabah sekizde ve aksam altida kutularin bos denetimden yuksek okumasi) capaliydi ve ayni kanit cumlesini cumle sonu eslestirme paketinin 9. kalemi kullaniyordu; daha kati kisitli tip kaldigi icin bu kalem kaydirildi. Yeni yuva H/2'de: H/1 hicbir deger tasimayan tek cumlelik gecis ('Then came the awkward part.'), H/4 ise cumle sonu eslestirmenin 9. kaleminin gercek kanit cumlesi (goreceli tur: o kalemin kaydi H/3 diyor ama alintiladigi cumle H/4'tur), dolayisiyla ikisi de kapali. Bosluk, calismanin kendi kurdugu girdinin adina aciliyor; bu kez baslik sozcugun kendisi ('mist') bilgiyi tasidigi icin ad obeginin tamami soruluyor - cerceve yalnizca 'onceki kosularda kullanilan sey' diyor, buna disaridan 'filtered air', 'test particles', 'laboratory air' gibi adaylar da uyar, dogru ad ancak H/2'den okunur. Eski cevap (kerria) artik ozette duz metin: hicbir kalemin cevabi degil ve cumle sonu eslestirmenin 9. kalemi acikligi baska bir gerekceye dayandirdigi icin sizinti yaratmiyor. H/2 yuvasi da 2026-08-18'de birakildi: capraz kok taramasi, 'prepared mist' dizgisinin cumle sonu eslestirmenin 6. kaleminin kokunde aynen gectigini olctu. Ayni gun cumle sonu eslestirmenin 9. kaleminin kayit hatasi duzeltilince (kaydi H/3 diyordu, alintiladigi cumle gercekte H/4) H/3 gercekten bosaldi, dolayisiyla kalem asil tasarimina dondu: yuva H/3, cevap aksam olcumunde bos denetimden yuksek okuyan tur. Ozet, en az tutan turu bilerek adlandirmiyor ('en duz ve en tuysuz yapraklar') ki bu ad mantikla degil yalniz H/3 okunarak bulunabilsin; 'kerria' dizgisi artik ozetin gorunur metninde ve baska hicbir okuma paketinin kokunde/secenek listesinde gecmiyor. H paragrafi bu kalem + cumle sonu eslestirmenin 9. kalemi ile 2 soruda kaliyor.
